resource_formulas.max_convolution_points_unit: 17 * (number of positive-width intersection intervals really integrated), cumulative over orders 2..N
resource_formulas.note: the design table (section 14) proposed 561*sum(n^2); neither it nor 561*sum(n) is a lower bound of the points really evaluated (Codex review, finding 5); equality with the limit passes
resource_formulas.tau_grid_per_eV: 10**(-3 + i/20) for i = 0, 1, ... while the value is <= 40/a (a = lower window edge in eV); 93 points for a = 1 eV; tau -> 0 is a further candidate only when the upper estimate of ||R||_1 is below 1
resource_formulas.work_estimate_after_first_order: 280.5 * sum(n * (P1 + n - 1) for n in 2..N), P1 = final first-order panels
resource_formulas.work_lower_bound_cells: n * (output bins + 2) for each folded order n in 2..N, compared with max_cells per order; not applied to the area entry
resource_formulas.work_lower_bound_points: 527 * sum(n for n in 2..N) (31 interior points per panel, n panels, one interval)
